definition: to travel from place to place
description: A bearded man in a dark three-piece suit and red tie rides a tall unicycle down the traffic lane of a busy city bridge on a sunny morning, beside the metal barrier. He holds a paper coffee cup in one gloved hand and a brown leather briefcase in the other, and his tie flies over his shoulder in the wind. A red double-decker bus, a black car and a yellow taxi move in the traffic behind him, with tall towers beyond. He sips his coffee as he rides, and a smiling cyclist follows him.
